services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -4.2 in August 2026, it is slightly below its five-year norm, improving from -6.5 a month earlier and -18.1 three months earlier, though below 2.9 six months earlier. ABS mining capex expectations is the largest positive contributor (+10.8), while QLD coal saleable tonnes is the largest negative contributor (-13.3).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. It reads 27.1 at 30 September 2026, above its five-year norm; it has eased from 29.4 a month earlier but remains above 25.7 three months ago and 11.9 six months ago. US new orders for iron and steel mills are the largest positive contributor (+25.0), while inverted AUD/USD is the largest negative contributor (-15.8); AISI capacity utilisation and discontinued CAT sales are excluded.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of fitter/welder vacancy tightness and AUD/USD against their own trailing 5-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -23.2 on 30 September 2026, it is below its 5-year norm and has weakened from -19.4 a month earlier and -7.9 three months earlier. AUD/USD is the biggest negative contributor (-36.8), partly offset by fitter/welder vacancy tightness (+13.6); the tungsten policy proxy is excluded pending sufficient history.
